LanguageData.LP_MagicMissile.label: magic missile
LanguageData.LP_MagicMissile.description: Cantrip, no mana: fire 3 arcane missiles, each 4 × arcane power arcane force damage, 28 cells, cooldown 5 seconds. Wizard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_MageArmor.label: mage armor
LanguageData.LP_MageArmor.description: For one day × arcane power, sharp and blunt armor +25%. Wizard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_Fireball.label: fireball
LanguageData.LP_Fireball.description: Hurl a fireball at a point within 24 cells: a fire explosion of radius 4, 20 × arcane power damage, setting things alight. Wizard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_Sleep.label: sleep
LanguageData.LP_Sleep.description: Put one target within 20 cells into magical sleep for 8 seconds × arcane power (consciousness reduced to 10%). No effect on mechanoids or targets whose consciousness is already below 30%; mind resistance can resist it. Wizard level 5.
LanguageData.LP_LightningBolt.label: lightning bolt
LanguageData.LP_LightningBolt.description: Draw a line of lightning up to 20 cells from yourself to the target; every enemy on the line takes 30 × arcane power lightning damage and is stunned for 1 second; mechanoids take EMP damage instead. Wizard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_Haste.label: haste
LanguageData.LP_Haste.description: Haste an ally within 20 cells for 1 hour × arcane power: movement ×1.5, work speed ×1.3, melee cooldown ×0.8; lethargic for an hour afterwards. Wizard level 7.
LanguageData.LP_WallOfStone.label: wall of stone
LanguageData.LP_WallOfStone.description: Create a 5-cell-long stone wall at a point within 20 cells (perpendicular to the cast direction, 200 × arcane power hit points, dissipates after a day); occupied cells are skipped. Wizard level 10.
LanguageData.LP_Teleport.label: teleport
LanguageData.LP_Teleport.description: Teleport yourself to any standable cell in sight, up to 20 × arcane power away (max 40). Wizard level 13.
LanguageData.LP_ShieldSpell.label: shield
LanguageData.LP_ShieldSpell.description: For 10 seconds an extra arcane shield surrounds you: damage taken is absorbed by it first, 20 × arcane power in total, until used up. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Wizard level 1.
LanguageData.LP_MistyStep.label: misty step
LanguageData.LP_MistyStep.description: Turn into silver mist and teleport to an empty cell in sight within 10 cells. Mana 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Wizard level 3.
LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.label: mirror image
LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.description: 3 illusory duplicates appear around you for 1 hour: each time an enemy attack hits, a duplicate takes it instead (the hit misses), until the duplicates are used up. Mana 2, cooldown 1 minute. Wizard level 5.
LanguageData.LP_Disintegrate.label: disintegrate
LanguageData.LP_Disintegrate.description: A green ray: a target within 30 cells takes 60 × arcane power arcane force damage (armor counts only half), double to buildings and mechanoids; humanlike targets killed by it leave no corpse. Wizard level 15, and Intellectual 15.
LanguageData.LP_CureWounds.label: cure wounds
LanguageData.LP_CureWounds.description: Instantly heal one target (can be yourself) for a total of 20 × divine power injury, worst bleeding wounds first. Cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_Bless.label: bless
LanguageData.LP_Bless.description: Bless an ally for 1 hour × divine power: melee hit +10%, better shooting accuracy, mood +3. Cleric level 1.
LanguageData.LP_LesserRestoration.label: lesser restoration
LanguageData.LP_LesserRestoration.description: Remove the target's worst disease (food poisoning, flu, plague, infection, muscle parasites, gut worms, etc.) and stop all bleeding for 6 hours. Cleric level 3.
LanguageData.LP_Guidance.label: guidance
LanguageData.LP_Guidance.description: Guide an ally for 1 hour × divine power: global work speed +15%, learning speed +30%. Cleric level 5.
LanguageData.LP_SacredFlame.label: divine strike
LanguageData.LP_SacredFlame.description: One enemy within 20 cells takes 20 × divine power holy damage, ignoring cover; doubled against undead, fiends and mind flayers. Cleric level 7.
LanguageData.LP_TurnUndead.label: turn undead
LanguageData.LP_TurnUndead.description: Hostile undead within radius 6 × divine power flee in terror for 10 seconds × divine power; mindless skeletons and necromantic constructs are stunned instead; liches are only slowed. Cleric level 7.
LanguageData.LP_MassHeal.label: mass cure wounds
LanguageData.LP_MassHeal.description: Heal every ally within radius 5 for 15 × divine power injury each. Cleric level 10.
LanguageData.LP_DeathWard.label: death ward
LanguageData.LP_DeathWard.description: Ward an ally for a day: pain ×0.5; when it would be downed by injuries, instantly heals 30 × divine power injury and uses up the ward (triggers once per day). Cleric level 13.
LanguageData.LP_Raise.label: revivify
LanguageData.LP_Raise.description: Revive a humanlike corpse within 12 cells that has been dead no more than 3 days (no effect on liches, necromantic constructs or corpses whose brains were devoured); the revived gets 3 days of "resurrection sickness". Cleric level 15, and Social 15.
LanguageData.LP_AnimalFriendship.label: calm beast
LanguageData.LP_AnimalFriendship.description: Calm one animal within 15 cells: a manhunting one returns to normal at once; a wild one has a chance to be tamed outright (35% × primal power × (1 - wildness / 2), up to 90%); on failure it runs away and does not fight back. Druid level 1.
LanguageData.LP_Entangle.label: entangle
LanguageData.LP_Entangle.description: Vines sprout in radius 2.5 at a point within 20 cells, entangling enemies for 4 seconds × verdant power: movement ×0.1 (×0.4 for body size 2+). Druid level 1.
LanguageData.LP_ConjureAnimals.label: conjure animals
LanguageData.LP_ConjureAnimals.description: Summon 2 spirit timber wolves nearby (3 at primal power ≥ 125%) that obey the caster, and vanish into motes of light after 1 day or on death, leaving no corpse. Druid level 3.
LanguageData.LP_Barkskin.label: barkskin
LanguageData.LP_Barkskin.description: Make an ally's skin like bark for 1 hour × verdant power: sharp armor +30%, blunt armor +15%, movement ×0.95. Druid level 5.
LanguageData.LP_WildShape.label: wild shape
LanguageData.LP_WildShape.description: Take bear form for 1 hour × primal power: ranged weapons go into the pack (re-equipped when changing back), fight with bear claws and bites, melee damage × primal power, damage taken ×0.6, movement ×1.15; cannot do crafting, research or caretaking work. Can "revert form" at any time. Druid level 7.
LanguageData.LP_PlantGrowth.label: plant growth
LanguageData.LP_PlantGrowth.description: All plants (crops and wild) within radius 6 × verdant power at a point within 25 cells gain +25% × verdant power growth (capped at 100%), and blight is removed. Druid level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BeastCommand.label: beast lord's call
LanguageData.LP_BeastCommand.description: Animals of your faction within radius 10 × primal power (including summoned spirit wolves) for 1 hour: melee damage ×(1 + 0.3 × primal power), movement ×1.2, damage taken ×0.8. Druid level 10.
LanguageData.LP_CallLightning.label: call lightning
LanguageData.LP_CallLightning.description: A lightning bolt strikes a point within 30 cells: enemies within radius 1.9 take 25 × verdant power electrical damage (mechanoids take EMP instead). In rain or thunderstorms, damage ×1.5 and cooldown halved. Druid level 13.
LanguageData.LP_ControlWeather.label: control weather
LanguageData.LP_ControlWeather.description: Open the weather window to choose a weather (clear, rain, fog, thunderstorm, and snow when at or below 0°C) that lasts 1 day, and end one negative weather event on this map (toxic fallout, cold snap, heat wave, volcanic winter, etc.; quest and permanent events excluded). Druid level 15, and Plants 15.
LanguageData.LP_ChaosBolt.label: chaos bolt
LanguageData.LP_ChaosBolt.description: Hurl chaotic energy at an enemy within 25 cells, 12 × innate power damage of a random type: fire (ignites), lightning (stuns), arcane force, frost (slows). 1/8 chance to leap to another enemy within 6 cells. Sorcerer level 1.
LanguageData.LP_BurningHands.label: burning hands
LanguageData.LP_BurningHands.description: Spray fire in a 90° cone 6 cells ahead: 18 × arcane power fire damage and ignites; the ground may catch fire. Sorcerer level 1.
LanguageData.LP_CharmPerson.label: charm person
LanguageData.LP_CharmPerson.description: Charm a humanlike: enemies fall into a daze for 8 seconds × innate power and stop attacking; prisoners lose 10 × innate power resistance. Mind resistance can resist it. Sorcerer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_TwinSpell.label: metamagic: twinned
LanguageData.LP_TwinSpell.description: The next single-target sorcerer spell within 30 seconds (Chaos Bolt, Charm Person) also affects another enemy within 6 cells of the main target. Sorcerer level 5.
LanguageData.LP_DragonWings.label: dragon wings
LanguageData.LP_DragonWings.description: Spread dragon wings and fly to a standable cell within 15 × innate power cells, untouchable while flying; +20% dodge for 15 seconds after takeoff. Sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_IceStorm.label: ice storm
LanguageData.LP_IceStorm.description: Bring down an ice storm at a point within 25 cells: enemies within radius 3 take 14 × arcane power frost damage plus half as much blunt damage and are slowed for 6 seconds; snow piles up on the ground. Sorcerer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_MassSuggestion.label: mass suggestion
LanguageData.LP_MassSuggestion.description: Hostile humanlikes within radius 4 at a point within 20 cells each resist with mind resistance; those who fail fall into a daze for 15 seconds × innate power. Sorcerer level 10.
LanguageData.LP_EmpoweredSpell.label: metamagic: empowered
LanguageData.LP_EmpoweredSpell.description: The next two sorcerer spells within 30 seconds deal ×1.5 damage. Sorcerer level 13.
LanguageData.LP_SorcerousSurge.label: wild surge
LanguageData.LP_SorcerousSurge.description: For 30 seconds × innate power: sorcerer spells cost no mana, cooldown ×0.25; each cast has a 20% chance of wild magic: healing light, invisibility, psychic resonance, blooming flowers, or spontaneous combustion, random teleport, entropy surge, chaotic spirits. Sorcerer level 15, and Social 15.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneWorkshop.label: arcane workshop
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneWorkshop.description: Passive: can craft the Arcane Workshop tier of DND weapons: subduing cudgel, net crossbow, slumber shortbow and slumber staff (also requires the research "subduing tactics"). Artificer level 1.
LanguageData.LP_QuickRepair.label: quick repair
LanguageData.LP_QuickRepair.description: Repair an ally's gear: the main weapon and each piece of apparel worn regain 25% durability. Cooldown 1 day. Artificer level 1.
LanguageData.LP_Overcharge.label: overcharged shot
LanguageData.LP_Overcharge.description: Within 10 seconds, your next ranged hit deals ×(1 + artifice power) damage, and the weapon used loses 5% durability. Artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_RuneInscription.label: rune inscription
LanguageData.LP_RuneInscription.description: Passive: the Rune Inscription tier of DND weapons (runic firearms have been removed since 1.146.0, so this tier currently has no craftable weapon). Artificer level 5.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCharge.label: arcane charge
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCharge.description: Infuse an ally with magic: for 30 seconds, +0.5 magic factor when using runic dwarven firearms and staves (no effect on other weapons). Artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_MasterCraft.label: master craftsmanship
LanguageData.LP_MasterCraft.description: Passive: +1 quality when crafting slumber staves (up to legendary; runic firearms and other staves have been removed since 1.146.0). Artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_MountainForge.label: mountain forge
LanguageData.LP_MountainForge.description: Passive: the forging method of dwarven royal heavy guns ("Wrath of the Mountain" has been removed since 1.146.0, so this ability currently has no craftable weapon). Artificer level 10.
LanguageData.LP_RuneTurretAbility.label: rune turret
LanguageData.LP_RuneTurretAbility.description: Place a temporary rune turret on an empty cell within 10 cells: runic arquebus stats × artifice power, lasting 60 seconds. Cooldown 2 days. Artificer level 13.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneResonance.label: arcane resonance
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneResonance.description: Passive: when you use runic dwarven firearms and staves, psychic sensitivity below 150% counts as 150%. Artificer level 15, and Crafting 15.
